question: How many customers are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers;

question: List the names of all customers from Sfax.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Sfax';

question: What is the price of the 'Standing Desk'?
gold_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE name = 'Standing Desk';

question: How many products are in the 'Electronics' category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics';

question: List all distinct product categories.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products;

question: How many orders have the status 'cancelled'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

question: What is the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the cheapest product in the 'Office' category?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Office' ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1;

question: List customer names who signed up before 2025-01-01.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date < '2025-01-01';

question: How many customers are from France?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'France';

question: What are the names of products priced under 15?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price < 15;

question: How many orders were placed in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;

question: List the distinct order statuses that exist.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders;

question: What is the average price of all products, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products;

question: List product names in the 'Sportswear' category ordered by price ascending.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Sportswear' ORDER BY price ASC;

question: How many orders does each status have? Show status and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status;

question: What is the total price of all products in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS total FROM products GROUP BY category;

question: How many products does each category have?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products GROUP BY category;

question: List the name of each customer along with the city they live in, for customers in Tunis.
gold_sql: SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Tunis';

question: For each order, show the order_id and how many line items it has.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_items FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id;

question: What is the total quantity sold for each product_id?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id;

question: List the order_id and order_date for orders placed by the customer named exactly 'Amine Trabelsi', if any exist.
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Amine Trabelsi';

question: Show the product name for every item in order number 1.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 1;

question: How many customers are there per country?
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country;

question: What is the highest unit_price ever recorded in order_items?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(unit_price) FROM order_items;

question: List the order_id of every order that has more than 3 line items.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

question: For each order, compute its total value (sum of quantity * unit_price). Show order_id and total.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id;

question: How many distinct customers have placed at least one order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders;

question: List the city and the number of customers in that city, only for cities with more than 3 customers.
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

question: What is the average quantity per line item across all order_items?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) FROM order_items;

question: Show the order_date and status for every order placed by customer_id 5.
gold_sql: SELECT order_date, status FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 5;

question: How many orders were placed in the year 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01';

question: List the names of customers who have never placed an order.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders);

question: What is the name of the customer who has placed the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the top 3 products by total quantity sold, showing product name and total quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 3;

question: For each customer, show their name and the total amount they've spent across all their orders (quantity * unit_price), ordered from highest spender to lowest.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Which product category generates the highest total revenue (quantity * unit_price)?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List customers who have spent more than 300 in total across all their orders. Show name and total spent.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING total_spent > 300;

question: What is the name of the product that has never been ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items);

question: For each country, show the total revenue generated by customers from that country.
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: List the order_id of orders whose total value (quantity * unit_price) exceeds the average order value across all orders.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM (  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) sub WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM (  SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id));

question: What is the name of the customer with the earliest signup_date?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers ORDER BY signup_date ASC LIMIT 1;

question: For each product, show its name and how many distinct orders it appeared in, only for products that appeared in more than 15 orders.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS n_orders FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING n_orders > 15;

question: List the 2 most recent orders (by order_date) that are still in 'placed' status, showing order_id and order_date.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'placed' ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 2;

question: What is the average order value (quantity * unit_price summed per order), rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);

question: List customers who have placed orders in both 'delivered' and 'cancelled' status. Show the customer name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled');

question: For each customer who has placed at least 5 orders, show their name and order count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING n_orders >= 5;

question: What is the second most expensive product overall?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

question: Show the category with the fewest total units sold (SUM of quantity), including categories with zero if any.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_qty FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_qty ASC LIMIT 1;

question: List the name and total spent of the single customer who has spent the most overall.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;
